svg.title: Let t be a finite rooted tree, with fields of degrees wlat its leaves, and centers zv and radii sv > 0 at internal vertices. Zero and one child are allowed. All subtree positions at v lie in radius Msv; different immediate child subtrees have separation at least ηsv. Internal child radii do not exceed parent radii. The root radius is r ↓0; no positive lower bound is imposed on child/parent ratios. Bounds on immediate centers imply these full subtree conditions after a small uniform upper ratio choice: if child displacement constants are Ci, set C′ = P i Ci and choose 0 < β ≤1, β ≤η/[4(C′ + 1)], below all previous child bounds. Descendant deviations are at most C′βsv, so sibling separation loses at most 2C′βsv ≤ηsv/2 and the parent displacement is at most (M + C′)sv. Induction gives the geometry. Put Wv = P lbelow v wland qv = sv/sparent(v), with virtual root-parent radius 1, so qroot = r. For fixed output degree m define
